response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong developer-tooling instincts (test runners, assertion libraries, a stint on the LabWindows/CVI C IDE, MCP code generators), but the core requirements of this role are not met. The resume shows no Kotlin, no Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate, no Gradle/Maven or application-server work, and only peripheral Java exposure (robotic arms and a device orchestration tool circa 2016-2018). His recent decade is overwhelmingly TypeScript/Node.js and D. Ramping a strong generalist into deep JVM/IDE internals for an enterprise Java product would be a long investment when the role explicitly demands existing depth in Java, Kotlin, and enterprise frameworks.
strengths: Prior IDE development experience (NI LabWindows/CVI in C/C++)
Built and maintained developer tooling: test runners, assertion libs, CI/CD
Long track record of end-to-end ownership across many stacks
concerns: No Kotlin and no Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience shown
Java listed as a skill but only used marginally, years ago
Recent work is TypeScript/Node/D, not JVM or large-scale systems
